title: Future Fashion
prompt_text: # ORBE — Future Mode · hero recreation brief Recreate this page exactly as described: a single self-contained `index.html` (inline CSS and JS, fonts embedded as base64 WOFF2, everything else loaded from the URLs below). It is a one-screen, non-scrolling, full-viewport futuristic hero. A black sci-fi HUD bezel frames a night sky above the clouds, where violet aurora ribbons whip across the sky (a looping video). A huge white geometric headline, "FUTURE MODE", scrolls sideways behind a glass 3D figure whose head is a glowing cyan halo ring with a planet orbiting inside it. "NEW" and "ERA" sit in the bottom corners, a chamfered "DISCOVER" button sits bottom centre, and the cursor leaves a liquid ribbed-glass trail through the sky while the figure turns to look at it. The page title is `ORBE — Future Mode` and the favicon is blank (``). Language: `en`. --- ## 1. Assets (use these exact URLs; never re-host, re-encode or compress them) | Use | URL | |---|---| | Sky still plate (2048×1360 PNG, 3:2). Shown through the image proxy at 2048 wide, WebP, q85 | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261105_170816_005f1a54-50e2-4842-b1b8-0b5d062fa432.png&w=2048&q=85` | | Sky still plate, raw | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261105_170816_005f1a54-50e2-4842-b1b8-0b5d062fa432.png` | | Sky loop video (Kling 3.0, 1276×720, 24 fps, 5.04 s, 16:9, silent, first frame = last frame) | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261105_173304_f896736c-46d1-4e39-996c-3ee39ad7c52f.mp4` | | Figure on flat chroma green (2048×1360 PNG, same framing as the plate). Placeholder until the 3D model loads. Through the proxy at 2048 wide, WebP, q92 | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261105_170812_0c57a015-bd35-401b-8233-f62bc609252f.png&w=2048&q=92` | | 3D glass figure (Tripo H3.1, GLB, ~14.7 MB, ~200k faces, PBR textures) | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261105_173920_6c4560d8-436c-4a04-a8c6-79224e8b156e.glb` | | three.js r160 (ES modules, via import map) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js` and addons from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/` (GLTFLoader.js, RoomEnvironment.js) | All Higgsfield/CloudFront and `images.higgs.ai` URLs send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Load every image, video and GLB that WebGL touches with `crossOrigin = "anonymous"`. The plate `` carries `crossorigin="anonymous"`. ### Fonts - **Share Tech Mono** 400, latin subset: `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/sharetechmono/v16/J7aHnp1uDWRBEqV98dVQztYldFcLowEF.woff2` - **Share Tech** 400, latin subset (used for the digit zero only): `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/sharetech/v23/7cHtv4Uyi5K0OeZ7bohU8H0JmA.woff2` Embed both as base64 `data:font/woff2` URLs under one family named **"Orbe Mono"**: 1. Face 1: Share Tech Mono, no `unicode-range`. 2. Face 2: Share Tech, `unicode-range: U+0030`. It is declared second, so every `0` renders as an unslashed zero while all other glyphs stay Share Tech Mono. Both faces use `font-display: block`. The stack is `"Orbe Mono", ui-monospace, monospace`. All text on the page uses this family. The big words (FUTURE MODE, NEW, ERA) are not text: they are vector outlines (see §5 and the appendix). ### Colours | Token | Value | Use | |---|---|---| | ink | `#f3f6ff` | all text, headline, NEW/ERA, labels | | cyan | `#5ef3ff` | button chip, button edge line, hover accents, focus ring | | bezel | `#030409` | HUD frame | | page background | `#0b0f3a` | `html, body` (behind everything) | `html, body`: height 100%, `overflow: hidden`, margin 0, `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`, `box-sizing: border-box` everywhere. --- ## 2. Coordinate system and layers Everything was measured on a **2048 × 1360 mockup frame (3:2)**, and every number below is in those frame units. There are two ways of mapping frame units to the screen: - **Cover frame**, for the sky and the figure. A 2048×1360 box centred in its stage, scaled to cover it: `--u = max(100cqw / 2048, 100cqh / 1360)`, with the stage as a size container (`container-type: size`). The box is `2048u × 1360u` at `left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%)`. On wide or tall screens it crops and never letterboxes. - **Pinned frame**, for all text and UI. It fills the viewport (`inset: 0`, no transform), with `--u = min(100vw / 2048, 100vh / 1150)`. The headline is anchored to the top, the words and button to the bottom, and the side copy to the vertical centre, so nothing is ever cropped. At exactly 3:2 the two units are equal and the layout matches the mockup pixel for pixel. The layers are full-viewport absolute boxes (`inset: 0; overflow: hidden`), bottom to top: 1. **stage-bg** (cover frame). The plate `` (object-fit cover), a hidden `
